d: Bittu Tabahi, whose real name is Surendra Singh Choudhary, is a young environmental activist from Byavra in Rajgarh district of Madhya Pradesh who has gained nationwide attention for single-handedly cleaning polluted rivers, ponds and water bodies across India. Known for his before-and-after videos of transforming dirty water bodies filled with plastic waste, sludge and toxic garbage, Bittu recently suffered a severe skin infection while cleaning the Ajnar River. Prolonged contact with stagnant toxic water, rotting waste and harmful chemicals caused his skin to peel, develop red rashes,…
